summary: Elapsed wait telemetry is recorded on both normal completion and abort while planned wait totals remain separate for budgeting.

evidence: The retry timer now measures monotonic elapsed time and reports it on both timer completion and abort.
The dispatch state keeps planned waitedMs separate from accumulated elapsedWaitMs across inline and deferred waits.
The cancellation fixture uses a 5-second planned wait interrupted after about 20 ms and asserts the recorded elapsed value is non-null and below 1 second.
